steps.zh: 从 PyPI 装上这个包

steps.en: Start a local rotating server, saying which proxy types and anonymity level you accept
steps.zh: 起一个本地轮换服务器，说明要哪类代理、什么匿名级别

steps.en: Scrapes ~50 public proxy-list sources for candidate addresses and drops duplicates
steps.zh: 从约 50 个公开代理列表抓候选地址，去掉重复

steps.en: Checks each candidate concurrently: protocol, anonymity level, Cookie/Referer support; keeps the survivors
steps.zh: 并发检查每个候选的协议、匿名级别和 Cookie/Referer 支持，留下活的

steps.en: Point your scraper's HTTP proxy setting at that local host and port
steps.zh: 把爬虫的 HTTP 代理设置指向这个本地端口

steps.en: Forwards each incoming request through a proxy from the pool, rotating automatically
steps.zh: 把每个进来的请求转给池里的某个代理，自动轮换

value.en: One local endpoint that rotates across free, pre-checked public proxies — no paid provider needed, but the pool is as flaky as free proxies are
value.zh: 一个本地端点在免费、已检查过的公开代理间轮换，不用买代理；但池子和免费代理一样不稳

sources: https://github.com/constverum/ProxyBroker#serve (proxybroker serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8888 --types HTTP HTTPS --lvl High; distributes incoming requests to a pool of found proxies)
https://github.com/constverum/ProxyBroker#features (~50 sources, checks Cookies/Referer, removes duplicates, automatic rotation)
